name: post-meeting
description: Process a meeting transcript into structured notes, action items, decisions, and follow-up emails

agents.name: transcript-reader
agents.prompt: Read and parse the meeting transcript into structured sections with speaker labels

agents.name: action-extractor
agents.prompt: Extract all action items with owners, deadlines, and priority levels

agents.name: decision-extractor
agents.prompt: Identify all key decisions, their rationale, and any deferred items

agents.name: summary-writer
agents.prompt: Compile the transcript, actions, and decisions into formatted meeting notes

agents.name: followup-drafter
agents.prompt: Draft personalized follow-up emails for each attendee with their action items
